about:
Vitality Casegoods Restorations & Furniture Manufacturing Inc., operating as Vitality Furniture, is based in Los Angeles, California. The company was established in 2003; ownership details and founders are not disclosed in the available information.

The company manufactures custom furniture and operates an event rental division. Its portfolio includes large-scale projects such as the renovation of the Westin Bonaventure Hotel's lobby, bar, and restaurant, as well as custom furniture for SoFi Stadium and Intuit Dome in Inglewood. Specific manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not provided.

Vitality Furniture serves the hospitality, restaurant, sports and entertainment, commercial property, and mixed-use development sectors. Notable clients include the Westin Bonaventure Hotel, Super Bowl LVI, the Rams Victory Celebration, SoFi Stadium, and Intuit Dome.

The company emphasizes innovative, sustainable designs and a focus on quality and exceptional service to create lasting value for clients worldwide.
